items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Yes, they said they had had Sweet Amel and several others.

ctx.x: Was that, I mean, did they have a piano player in the band before you?
Yes, they said they had had Sweet Amel and several others.
So, so you weren't the first woman to play the band. Oh, yes. Was there, did you see many women playing piano with bands around here out of the... Yes.
